result.instructions: Tools for Donorbox, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our campaigns raised the most this year?"; "List donations from the last 30 days over $500."; "Show all recurring plans started in 2026 for the spring appeal.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Donorbox data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run donorbox_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run donorbox_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run donorbox_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. donorbox_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: donorbox_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List your Donorbox campaigns with goal, currency, total raised, formatted amounts and donation counts. Good first call to find campaign ids for the other tools. Donorbox API: GET /api/v1/campaigns.

id.description: Only the campaign with this id.

tools.name: donorbox_list_donations
tools.title: List donations
tools.description: List donations with amount, currency, status, donation date, donor, campaign, designation, comment, UTM source and custom question answers. Filter by campaign, donor, email, name, date range or amount range. Donorbox API: GET /api/v1/donations.

id.description: Only the donation with this id.

campaign_id.description: Only donations for this campaign id.

campaign_name.description: Only donations for this campaign name.

donor_id.description: Only donations by this donor id.

email.description: Only donations from this donor email.

first_name.description: Only donations from donors with this first name.

last_name.description: Only donations from donors with this last name.

date_from.description: Donations on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_to.description: Donations on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

currency.description: Currency code for the amount range, lowercase (default usd), e.g. usd, eur.

amount_min.description: Minimum amount in the given currency.

amount_max.description: Maximum amount in the given currency.

tools.name: donorbox_list_donors
tools.title: List donors
tools.description: List donors (name, email, address, employer, occupation, country). Filter by donor id, name or email. Donorbox API: GET /api/v1/donors.

id.description: Only the donor with this id.

first_name.description: Only donors with this first name.

last_name.description: Only donors with this last name.

email.description: Only the donor with this email.

tools.name: donorbox_list_plans
tools.title: List recurring plans
tools.description: List recurring donation plans (monthly or other schedules) with amount, status and donor. Filter by campaign, donor, email, name or start-date range. Donorbox API: GET /api/v1/plans.

campaign_id.description: Only plans for this campaign id.

campaign_name.description: Only plans for this campaign name.

donor_id.description: Only plans of this donor id.

email.description: Only plans of this donor email.

first_name.description: Only plans of donors with this first name.

last_name.description: Only plans of donors with this last name.

date_from.description: Plans created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_to.description: Plans created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: donorbox_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List your Donorbox events (ticketed events and their details). Donorbox API: GET /api/v1/events.

tools.name: donorbox_list_tickets
tools.title: List event tickets
tools.description: List event tickets. Pass payment_status=refunded to list only refunded tickets. Donorbox API: GET /api/v1/tickets.

payment_status.description: Only refunded tickets (the one value the API documents).

tools.name: donorbox_list_event_purchases
tools.title: List event purchases
tools.description: List event ticket purchases. payment_status is one of succeeded (default), pending, failed or refunded. Donorbox API: GET /api/v1/purchases.
